summary.text: Samantha Steckloff is the Democratic state representative for Michigan House District 19, a member of the Michigan House since 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a lifelong Farmington Hills resident who was elected to the Farmington Hills City Council in 2013.

paragraphs.text: Samantha Steckloff was born in Farmington Hills, Michigan, and graduated from Harrison High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Purdue University in 2006.

Her career experience includes working as an enrollment management coordinator and student service specialist with Wayne State University, an automotive spokesperson and consultant, and a program director with Hillel.
She has volunteered with the Commission on Children Youth and Families, the Community Health Commission and the Farmington Hills Parks and Recreation Commission, among other groups.
In the survey, Steckloff said she was elected to the Michigan House in 2020 and serves on the House Appropriations Committee.
She said she is Minority Vice Chair of the Appropriations Subcommittee on Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy and previously chaired the subcommittee on Higher Education and Community Colleges.
She listed education access and affordability, health care costs and infrastructure, including roads and water systems, among her key messages.
